newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Portugal Oct CPI seen up 0.1-0.3 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Portugal Oct CPI seen up 0.1-0.3 pct m/m.

text.p: Portugal's October consumer price index is expected to rise between 0.1 and 0.3 percent from unchanged September levels, analysts said.

This would give a year-on-year rate of 3.1 to 3.4 percent compared with 3.4 percent in September and push the rolling 12-month average down to 3.2 percent from 3.3 percent in September, they said. The average rate is the government's benchmark.
The National Statistics Institute will release the inflation figures at 1500 GMT on Wednesday.
A year ago, the October month-on-month increase was 0.4 percent, with the average rate at 4.2 percent and the year-on-year rate at 4.0 percent.
